title: A Cellar for the Winter
author: Wendell Hartwell
blurb: Hazel Dravenmoor, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
